module: "consoleNG" development console in ImGui ("beamng.consoleNG" window). It displays the game log (read every frame via Engine.getFrameLog) with filters by level (E, W, I, D, A), filter by origin as a Lua pattern, pause (Pause key), log statistics and auto-scroll. It also lets you run commands in four contexts: game engine Lua (GE), TorqueScript, interface JavaScript (CEF) or the Lua of a specific vehicle. A modder opens it with ui_console.toggle() to debug.
usage:
extensions.load('ui_console')
ui_console.show()   -- opens the window
ui_console.toggle() -- opens or closes
notes: The window settings (font size, level filters, fullscreen, transparency, history wraparound, sandbox mode, focus on open, vehicle control) are saved in /settings/consoleNG.json; the command history (20 entries at most) is in /consoleHistory.json and reloaded if this file changes (onFileChanged).

Execution contexts (drop-down list): 0 = GE Lua, 1 = TorqueScript (a ";" is added if missing), 2 = interface JS (be:queueJS), then "Current Vehicle" and one item per active vehicle (v:queueLuaCommand).

In GE Lua, if the "Sandbox GE Commands" option is active, the command goes through executeLuaSandboxed(cmd, 'GEConsole'); otherwise it is sent by Lua:queueLuaCommand after a logged hex dump. The variable is true in the code, but settingsLoad sets it to false if the settings file does not contain it.
When the window is open, the VehicleCommonActionMap and VehicleSpecificActionMap actions are disabled unless "enableVehicleControls" is true; they are re-enabled on close.
The log filter uses Lua patterns (string.match), not regular expressions; an invalid pattern is detected by pcall and its error message is displayed.
The log is a circular buffer bounded by logsLimit = 1000 lines.
ConsoleInputCallback is a global function called by ImGui to navigate the history with the up and down arrows.

Inconsistencies: M.inputCallback and M.onExtensionUnloaded are assigned from local variables that are never defined and are therefore nil; parseLogLine calls M.onConsoleLog, which no longer exists (hook removed, line commented out), which would cause an error for an unparseable log line; settingsLoad uses 0.64 as the default font size while the initial value is 0.95.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: ui_imgui.

inputCallback.desc: Always nil: assigned from a nonexistent local variable (bug).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Always nil: assigned from a nonexistent local variable (bug), so there is no unload hook.

toggle.desc: Opens the window if it is closed, closes it if it is open.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame. If the window is open, reads the new log lines (except when paused), draws the ImGui console and processes the commands entered; on close, gives vehicle control back.

dtReal.desc: Real frame duration in seconds (not used).

dtSim.desc: Simulated frame duration in seconds (not used).

dtRaw.desc: Raw frame duration in seconds (not used).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: loads the settings and history, initializes the editor's ImGui theme and builds the list of execution contexts.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload: saves the window state (open, origin filter, input in progress, level filter, fullscreen, position, scroll).

returns.desc: Data to hand back to onDeserialized.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload: restores the state saved by onSerialize.

onFileChanged.desc: Hook called when a watched file changes. Reloads the history if the file is /consoleHistory.json.

onVehicleActiveChanged.desc: Hook called when a vehicle becomes active or inactive: rebuilds the list of execution contexts (refreshCombo).

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: rebuilds the list of execution contexts.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is spawned: rebuilds the list of execution contexts.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the player's vehicle changes: rebuilds the list of execution contexts.
